An Immersive Journey Through the Mahabharata | Krishna, Arjuna & the War Within
Description:
Welcome to a moving and spiritually enriching audiovisual presentation that blends the timeless message of the Bhagavad Gita, drama from the Mahabharata, and the profound questions of life that echo across generations. With evocative background music, rich narration, and poetic expression in Kannada, Malayalam, Sanskrit, Telugu, and more, this presentation is not just a story—it's a spiritual awakening.
